title: CCTV Review — Unauthorized Access to Electrical Room B

fields.organization: North Coast Regional Airport Authority — Security & Law Enforcement
fields.location: Door S-4 (Concourse B) and Door S-6 (Non-Sterile Exit)
fields.summary: CCTV review of Door S-4 access at 07:38 and exit at 08:07 confirms unauthorized individual used a cloned badge to enter and exit the secure corridor. The individual, male, 5'10", wearing a grey maintenance jumpsuit, baseball cap, and black backpack, was not recognized as an airport employee or vendor. The badge on his lanyard was a plain white card without photo, hologram, or standard NCIA branding. No camera coverage exists in the maintenance corridor M-3 or inside Electrical Room B. The subject carried the backpack heavier upon exit. The access pattern matches the PACS log for the duplicate credential event.

findings.notes: Event timestamped 07:38:12; badge read at 125 kHz; no biometric verification; unauthorized individual.
Event timestamped 08:07:44; same badge; no secondary verification; subject not in employee or vendor database.
Visual confirmed: unknown male in maintenance attire; badge appears to be a blank T5577 card; no photo or hologram; lanyard not standard issue.
Same subject; backpack appears heavier on exit; no visible tools, but load suggests equipment was carried.
No camera installed; access to Electrical Room B unmonitored.
No internal CCTV; access via unmonitored corridor; no environmental sensors detected.
Plain white card; not a standard NCIA badge; likely a T5577 card programmed with Mendez’s 125 kHz credential.
Visual weight differential noted; may have contained network tools or rogue access point components.
No signs of forced entry; door remained locked externally as per fail-secure policy.
PACS logged event; no system failure detected; system responded normally to access attempt.

actionsTaken: Reviewed CCTV footage from 07:38 to 08:07 at Door S-4 and S-6
Cross-referenced subject image with employee and vendor databases; no match found
Notified IT and OPS Command of unauthorized access pattern
Initiated facial image search with TSA and FBI fusion center
Flagged missing camera coverage in M-3 corridor and E-2 room
recommendations: Immediately install camera in maintenance corridor M-3 between S-4 and E-2
Audit all access point logs for duplicate 125 kHz credential events over past 72 hours
Conduct physical inspection of Electrical Room B for unauthorized devices
Update badge policy to disable legacy 125 kHz mode on all issued cards
Issue alert to all staff: report any unmarked white badge seen on lanyard
fields.photosNote: 4 photos attached: IMG_20261022_0825_S1 (S-4 entry), IMG_20261022_0825_S2 (S-4 full view), IMG_20261022_0825_S3 (S-6 exit), IMG_20261022_0825_S4 (backpack weight comparison)

instructorNote: This inject confirms the attacker’s physical presence and movement. The lack of camera coverage in M-3 and E-2 is a critical gap. The team must now link the video evidence to the PACS log and the T5577 card to deduce that the rogue AP was likely installed in E-2.
